buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BUYER ADDED BID TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates /documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 2. Buyer Added ATC document overrides all the Standard, Technical Specifications and General Conditions of the bid. 3. Manufacturer Authorization Certificate - The bidder must Submit the Ink Signed Authorization Certific ate from the OEM specifically for this bid. 4. Pre-loaded Operating System (Windows)- The Windows 11 Professional Operating System has to be pre-loaded by the OEM and Bidder has to submit documentary proof specifically for this bid, on OEM letter head that it will be pre-loaded by OEM at its premises and will not be installed by bidder. 5. Technical Specifications Compliance Sheet as per bid specific with respect to each technical parameter as ked in bid has to match with quoted product and must be submitted by the bidder on OEM Letter head dul y signed by OEM. 6. Datasheet of the offered product by the OEM has to be uploaded to verify the specifications quoted by the bidder. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. OEM compliance letter showi ng line by line compliance for the quoted product technical specification should be submitted on OEM lette rhead, specific bid number should be mentioned along with Compliance letter. 7. The offered computer has to be Make in India Certified with minimum content 20 percent or more. The OE M has to provide MII declaration of the same on their letterhead stating the same with GEM Catalogue ID. 8. All other peripherals i.e. Keyboard, Mouse, Monitor should be of the same OEM make as that of the Deskto p Computer. OEM logo must be embossed at Keyboard, Mouse, Monitor, NO STICKERS ALLOWED. 9. Bidder/ supplier/ Organization/Proprietor/ Any of the Director(s) shall not be banned or suspended or black listed in last three years by any Government/Public Sector Undertaking/Corporate Organization or convicte d in any Court of law across India. An affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper must be uploaded on GeM Port al and should not be old than 90 days before the bid initiation date. 10. Bidder has to submit an undertaking regarding not being suspended on GeM Portal (in past 3 years from t he date of Bid Publication) for delivering inferior-quality, refurbished products, submitting fake, forged or misleading authorization documents, test reports or certifications. Failure to deliver products or execute se rvices within the agreed timeline, refusing or denying delivery after a direct-purchase contract is placed. Bi dder/OEM offer is liable to be rejected if any such incident is reported. 11. Bidder has to submit a notarized affidavit regarding Authenticity of the experience, other ATC certificates f rom OEM and turnover documents uploaded for participating in the bid. The uploaded documents can be v erified by the buyer and if any discrepancy found, the bidder will be black-listed for future participation an d the same intimation will also be uploaded on GeM Portal (Format Attached in PDF file of ATC). 12. Product offered should not be discontinued for next three years and OEM will provide all required spare pa rts/services related to the product supplied. Undertaking from OEM must be attached. 13. The Bidder must upload their valid GST Registration Certificate and PAN. 14. OEM should have manufacturing facility in India with valid own manufacturing license (verifiable) and BIS

certification of quoted product for the last 5 years. BIS of the offered/quoted product model should be verifi able online from BIS website. 15. On-site Warranty of the offered product should be available through serial number search / tracking on the website of the OEM. OEM must have built-in system hardware diagnostics facility and download updates of software, device drivers, and firmware on OEM website. 16. OEM must have Functional Service Centre in Chandigarh/Mohali/Panchkula and proof of its operations for a t-least previous 3 Years must be submitted by OEM. Latest Documentary and location evidence indicating the above may be submitted in support of the above on OEM Letterhead. 17. Bidder has to make sure that the installation of the material delivered must be carried out by the bidder p ersonnel within the stipulated time frame assigned by the buyer. 18. After award of contract, bidder must submit the requisite ePBG amount as in the prescribed format in the b id document within 15 days. The final payment of material delivered will only be released after verification of the ePBG submitted. 19. The bidder should submit an undertaking on letterhead that he/she is not involved in any type of cartelin g while participating in the bid. Minimum Required Technical Specifications: Desktop Computer (Standard) S. No Item Specifications 1 Form Factor Tower/Micro Tower/Mini Tower 2 Chassis Tool-less Chassis 3 Chipset Commercial Class Intel® 800 series Chipset or higher 4 Processor Intel® Core™ Ultra 7 2nd Generation Processor (up to 5.3 GHz with Intel® Turbo Boost Max Technology, 30 MB L3 cache, 20 c ores, 20 threads) with Intel® Graphics or higher Intel®AI Boost 13 TOPS or higher NPU Supportability 5 Memory 16 GB DDR5 - 4800MHz Memory expandability up to 64 GB wit h 02 DIMM Slots or higher 6 Storage 512 GB PCIe NVMe SSD or higher 7 Graphics Intel® Graphics or higher Audio Integrated audio controller with internal speaker of at least 2W in CPU 8 Operating Syst Microsoft Windows 11 Professional with OEM Recovery DVD or em option of Cloud Recovery or higher 9 Networking Integrated Intel Gigabit 10/100/1000 Ethernet Controller or hig her Intel® Wi-Fi 6E AX211 802.11ax 2x2 with Bluetooth or higher 10 Ports Video: 1 X Display Port ,1 XHDMI port USB:3 USB 2.0, 2 USB 3.0, 3 USB 3.2 Gen 2 and atleast 1 USB Type C 10Gbps in front

11 Slots 1X PCI Express x16 1 X M.2 for WLAN & 2X M.2 for Storage 2X SATA Ports 12 Keyboard USB Wired Keyboard 13 Mouse USB Optical Wired Mouse 14 Power Supply 250 W with 85% efficiency or better 15 Security Hardware based endpoint security controller TPM 2.0 16 Manageability IT Asset management software from same OEM is must. 17 Certifications Microsoft Windows 11, FCC,CE, RoHS, UL, EPEAT India, Energy Star, ISO 9001,14001, 20001,27001 for OEM 18 Display 24" IPS with Minimum resolution of 1920*1080, with VGA/ HDM I/ DP, TCO 9.0 Certified (Same OEM as desktop) 19 Warranty 3 Years onsite . 3.
